##Libraries

```{r}
library(ggplot2)
library(tidyr)
library(tidyverse)
library(dplyr)
library(gt)

```


##Load the data

```{r}

trial_data <- read.csv(
  "C:/Users/39351/github/clinical-Trial-Biostatistics/data/simulated/clinical_trial_data.csv",
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

```


## UNADJUSTED TREATMENT COMPARISON: Mean Difference

```{r}


# mean LDL reduction in each group
mean_reduction <- aggregate(
  ldl_reduction ~ treatment,
  data = trial_data,
  FUN = mean
)

print(mean_reduction)


# the difference between group means
control_mean <- mean(
  trial_data$ldl_reduction[
    trial_data$treatment == "Control"
  ]
)

treatment_mean <- mean(
  trial_data$ldl_reduction[
    trial_data$treatment == "New treatment"
  ]
)

mean_difference <- treatment_mean - control_mean


print(mean_difference)

```

## UNADJUSTED TREATMENT COMPARISON:Welch's T-test

```{r}

trial_data$treatment <- factor(
  trial_data$treatment,
  levels = c("Control", "New treatment")
)

# Welch's t-test: new treatment minus control
unadjusted_test <- t.test(
  x = trial_data$ldl_reduction[
    trial_data$treatment == "New treatment"
  ],
  y = trial_data$ldl_reduction[
    trial_data$treatment == "Control"
  ],
  var.equal = FALSE
)


# unadjusted analysis results
unadjusted_results <- data.frame(
  Analysis = "Unadjusted: mean LDL reduction",
  Estimate = unadjusted_test$estimate[1] -
             unadjusted_test$estimate[2],
  Lower_CI = unadjusted_test$conf.int[1],
  Upper_CI = unadjusted_test$conf.int[2],
  P_value = unadjusted_test$p.value
)



```



## PRIMARY ANALYSIS:  ADJUSTED REGRESSION MODEL (ANCOVA)


```{r}

# the reference group = Control
trial_data$treatment <- relevel(
  trial_data$treatment,
  ref = "Control"
)


# Fit the adjusted linear regression model
ancova_model <- lm(
  week12_ldl ~ treatment + baseline_ldl,
  data = trial_data
)


#summary(ancova_model)

#the 95% confidence intervals
confint(ancova_model, level = 0.95)

# the treatment effect
treatment_effect <- coef(ancova_model)[
  "treatmentNew treatment"
]

# standard error
treatment_se <- summary(ancova_model)$coefficients[
  "treatmentNew treatment", "Std. Error"
]

# p-value
treatment_p <- summary(ancova_model)$coefficients[
  "treatmentNew treatment", "Pr(>|t|)"
]

# the key results
cat("Adjusted treatment effect:", treatment_effect, "\n")
cat("Standard error:", treatment_se, "\n")
cat("P-value:", treatment_p, "\n")

# treatment effect confidence interval
confint(
  ancova_model,
  "treatmentNew treatment",
  level = 0.95
)



# Adjusted ANCOVA results
ancova_ci <- confint(
  ancova_model,
  "treatmentNew treatment",
  level = 0.95
)

ancova_results <- data.frame(
  Analysis = "Adjusted: week-12 LDL (ANCOVA)",
  Estimate = coef(ancova_model)["treatmentNew treatment"],
  Lower_CI = ancova_ci[1],
  Upper_CI = ancova_ci[2],
  P_value = summary(ancova_model)$coefficients[
    "treatmentNew treatment", "Pr(>|t|)"
  ]
)

```


## Visualise the ANCOVA-adjusted group means

```{r}

# the overall mean baseline LDL
mean_baseline <- mean(
  trial_data$baseline_ldl,
  na.rm = TRUE
)

# Creating prediction dataset
prediction_data <- data.frame(
  treatment = factor(
    c("Control", "New treatment"),
    levels = c("Control", "New treatment")
  ),
  baseline_ldl = mean_baseline
)

# predicted means and confidence intervals
predictions <- as.data.frame(
  predict(
    ancova_model,
    newdata = prediction_data,
    interval = "confidence",
    level = 0.95
  )
)

# Combining predictions with treatment groups
adjusted_means <- cbind(
  prediction_data,
  predictions
)





# Plot
ggplot(
  adjusted_means,
  aes(x = treatment, y = fit)
) +
  geom_point(size = 2) +
  geom_errorbar(
    aes(ymin = lwr, ymax = upr),
    width = 0.10
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Adjusted mean LDL at week 12",
    subtitle = paste(
      "Predictions adjusted to baseline LDL =",
      round(mean_baseline, 1), "mg/dL"
    ),
    x = "Treatment group",
    y = "Predicted week-12 LDL (mg/dL)"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()

```



## Display the Table of Results for both Analysis

```{r}

# Combine both analyses
results_table <- bind_rows(
  unadjusted_results,
  ancova_results
)



results_table %>%
  gt() %>%
  tab_header(
    title = "Treatment Effect on LDL Cholesterol",
    subtitle = "Randomised clinical trial — 12-week follow-up"
  ) %>%
  cols_label(
    Analysis = "Analysis",
    Estimate = "Mean difference (mg/dL)",
    Lower_CI = "95% CI lower",
    Upper_CI = "95% CI upper",
    P_value = "P-value"
  ) %>%
  fmt_number(
    columns = c(Estimate, Lower_CI, Upper_CI),
    decimals = 2
  ) %>%
  fmt_number(
    columns = P_value,
    decimals = 3
  ) %>%
  tab_source_note(
    source_note = paste(
      "Negative differences favour the new treatment.",
      "Unadjusted comparison uses Welch's t-test.",
      "The ANCOVA model adjusts for baseline LDL."
    )
  )

```



## Visualise the treatment effects

It displays the **estimated treatment difference** and its 95% confidence interval.


```{r}

ggplot(results_table, aes(y = Analysis, x = Estimate)) +

  geom_vline(
    xintercept = 0,
    linetype = "dashed",
    colour = "darkred"
  ) +

  geom_segment(
    aes(
      x = Lower_CI,
      xend = Upper_CI,
      yend = Analysis
    ),
    linewidth = 1
  ) +

  geom_point(size = 3) +

  labs(
    title = "Estimated treatment effects on LDL cholesterol",
    subtitle = "Mean difference and 95% confidence intervals",
    x = "Mean difference (mg/dL): new treatment minus control",
    y = NULL,
    caption = paste(
      "Negative values favour the new treatment.",
      "The two estimates concern different outcome definitions."
    )
  ) +

  theme_minimal(base_size = 12)
  
```
